title: event-custom-tabs.html
content: You can add unlimited {{variable.Object_CustomContent}} to your {{variable.Object_Event}} . (But don't add too many; it won't look good.) Your Attendees will see the {{variable.Object_CustomContent}} , previously called Custom Tabs, under the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} ’s webpage’s {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustomTabs}} tab. Enable Custom Tabs in Event Settings Navigate to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustomTabs}} to {{variable.picklist_Always}} . Create a Custom Content Record Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_CustomContent}} {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} on your {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Can't find the Related List? If you don't see the Custom Content Related List, edit the Event page layout and add the Custom Content object as a Related List. Enter the relevant information. View the Live Custom Tab Perform a hard refresh on the Event page and you will see the Custom Tab with your {{variable.Object_CustomContent}} ! Embedded Video You can also add embedded videos as Custom Content.
